extracted.intended_audience: Wikipedia contributors / users attempting to create a new article (especially new editors)
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance for creating or locating a Wikipedia article with a given title: checks to perform before creating a page, account requirements, and options for submitting drafts or requesting pages. Focused on practical steps new editors should follow when an exact-title page is missing.

rubrics_metrics.name: Search for existing/alternative titles or spellings
rubrics_metrics.description: Please search for 'SNL 50th anniversary special' in Wikipedia to check for alternative titles or spellings.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Look for pages within Wikipedia that link to this title. Use the search function before creating a new article to avoid duplicates under different spellings or phrasing.

rubrics_metrics.name: Account and autoconfirmed requirement to create articles
rubrics_metrics.description: You need to log in or create an account and be autoconfirmed to create new articles.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If you are not logged in or not autoconfirmed you cannot create the page directly; consider the alternative submission paths (article wizard, draft submission, or requesting a new article).

rubrics_metrics.name: Use the article wizard or request a new article / submit a draft
rubrics_metrics.description: Alternatively, you can use the article wizard to submit a draft for review, or request a new article.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If you lack permissions or prefer review, prepare a draft and follow the wizard or request-process so experienced editors can review and help publish the article.

rubrics_metrics.name: Check for recent creation delays and try purging
rubrics_metrics.description: If a page was recently created here, it may not be visible yet because of a delay in updating the database; wait a few minutes or try the purge function.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If you believe the page exists but you cannot see it, wait briefly and then use the purge page function to refresh cached database results.

rubrics_metrics.name: Check the deletion log if a page was removed
rubrics_metrics.description: If the page has been deleted, check the deletion log, and see 'Why was the page I created deleted?'
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Consult the deletion log to learn whether the page was removed and the reasons given; this can inform whether and how to recreate the article.

rubrics_metrics.name: Consider case sensitivity and add redirects for capitalization variants
rubrics_metrics.description: Titles on Wikipedia are case sensitive except for the first character; please check alternative capitalizations and consider adding a redirect here to the correct title.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Verify capitalization variants and, if appropriate, create redirects from alternative capitalizations to the canonical article title to aid discoverability.

rubrics_metrics.name: Look for incoming links to the title
rubrics_metrics.description: Look for pages within Wikipedia that link to this title.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Finding existing links that point to the intended title can indicate where a redirect is needed or whether other articles reference the topic; use this to decide naming and linkage.
